segments.text: Today we will discuss photosynthesis in plants.
Photosynthesis converts light energy into chemical energy.
The chemical equation is 6 CO2 plus 6 H2O plus light yields C6H12O6 plus 6 O2.
This was first demonstrated by Jan Ingenhousz in 1779.
Plants appear green because chlorophyll absorbs red and blue light.
Now let's move on to cellular respiration.
Cellular respiration breaks down glucose to release energy as ATP.
